## Installation

Flash the binary for your board. See [Flashing](https://ph1p.github.io/ikea-led-obegraensad/getting-started/flashing) and [OTA updates](https://ph1p.github.io/ikea-led-obegraensad/getting-started/ota).

## Default configuration

- **Hostname:** ikea-led
- **OTA username:** admin
- **OTA password:** ikea-led-wall
- **Wi-Fi SSID:** WifiForIkeaLamp (ESP8266 only)
- **Wi-Fi password:** WifiPasswordForIkeaLamp (ESP8266 only)

ESP32 boards open an access point if they cannot connect to Wi-Fi.
